response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrated experience in agentic AI systems at scale, fintech infrastructure, or regulated AI deployment, with no evidence of multi-agent architecture, real-time credit/risk systems, or leadership scaling engineering teams beyond 10 people — all hard requirements for the role.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering background across multiple languages and domains
Experience with event-driven systems and open-source platform development
Proven ability to build and ship complex software in diverse environments
concerns: No evidence of production multi-agent AI systems or LLM orchestration in fintech
Lacks demonstrated leadership in scaling engineering teams to 30+ or governing hybrid outsourced models
No mention of regulatory compliance, credit risk modeling, or financial infrastructure experience
